name: Aquacreep!
storyline: When an alien shapeshifter poses as human, who will you trust? In a scenario that plays like the movie "The Thing", a shapeshifter has infiltrated your diving crew, and now you must figure which of them is human, and which is something else...
summary: A spin-off of the "Astrocreep" games, a series about an alien that assimilates other organisms (like "The Thing"). This is a story-driven installment that changes on each playthrough. In order to do well, you need to explore and investigate to gather all the info you can! Be smart to survive, good luck, and trust no one!
